what: Sweeping the cursor over a photo (or an SVG wordmark) writes the passed path into a 40×40 flow grid at speed ×2600 within a radius of 3 cells, decaying by .08 each frame. The image is pushed .09 by that flow while the R and B channels shift ±18% more and less so they split apart, and where flow is strong (strength ×15) it breaks into 5px blocks, then settles back to the original image within 1 second after the mouse stops (OGL · WebGL)

options.displace: Size the picture is pushed (panel ratio), default .09
options.rgb: Share by which R·B shift more or less, default .18
options.block: Side length of each breaking chunk (px), default 5
options.pixel: Flow strength → chunk share multiplier, default 15
options.decay: Fraction that fades out per frame, default .08
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Image to draw — img (cover fit), canvas (as is — if it was redrawn, send fx:refresh to the element), inline svg (drawn with currentColor replaced by the text color), and if empty, it draws that element’s placeholder (background·diagonal·data-label)
options.look: With cells, flow cells are not blended but pushed whole per cell, so the photo shifts like a mosaic (original 34×34 cells · nearest-cell read). Default blends smoothly between cells
options.settle: When first seen, each cell is offset by roughly ±9px, then from the bottom center cell they release one after another over this many seconds and settle with decay, default 0 (none) — when the original portrait photos turn on (Brand site first page arrival: settle 1.85)

from.where: index.html Hero photo .sg-img--glitch · footer wordmark on every page
index.html Hero portrait photo (.gz-hero__portrait) — reads a 34×34 cell offset map by nearest cell, shifting cell by cell, no splitting or lumps
from.options: grid: 34; look: cells; rgb: 0; pixel: 0; displace: .06

note: The original also applies a gray color grade (matrix + 6-step curve) to photos, but that is skin tied to photo selection, so it was left out and only the flow distortion was extracted. It is not applied on touch devices (no hover) or with reduced motion — the original picture shows as is
